scope: One separately approved macOS host compile/load and synthetic A1-B-A2 direct Core ML mechanical check; no production or recognizer adoption.

route.host: macOS 27.0.1, arm64 binary with macOS13 deployment target
route.API: MLModel.compileModel, MLModel load and synchronous prediction; no Vision or Apple Intelligence API in probe
route.model: Exact previously inspected Apple MobileNetV2 INT8-LUT artifact, unchanged
route.CPU: CPU-only requested and configuration readback matched; no independent kernel observation
route.input: Two fixed procedural 224x224 RGB8 patterns; explicit BGRA pixel-buffer write and active-row hash check. No decoder/rendering, resize/crop/orientation transform or external normalization; embedded model preprocessing retained.

schema.duplicateLabel: crane occurs at zero-based positional labels 135 and 518 but only one dictionary key. Returned dictionary values were retained without inventing separate positional scores, renormalizing or establishing a merge rule. Sums are descriptive.

frozenNumericCriteria.perVector: 1000 original unique keys; finite values in[0,1]; span>1e-8

retainedNumericResult.readback: Root independently decoded Float64 binaries in Python and checked JSON/key/byte/hash consistency and ordered arithmetic. Separate retained-record review found matching frozen identities, counters, vector hashes and results; it did not rerun inference.

priorVisionFailures.meaning: Earlier component extraction, CI-witness startup and direct Vision CI/CGImage repeat failures remain separate historical results. This host model check neither diagnoses nor fixes them and establishes no representation/backend/platform equivalence.

limits: These synthetic nonfood patterns do not evaluate food naming, ingredients, portions, nutrients, insulin, world-cuisine coverage, food-like/nonfood/unknown classification, confidence calibration or abstention.
No iOS/Simulator/physical-device portability, network-isolated offline-device, speed/memory/final compressed package, training, adoption or submission acceptance.

The embedded license pointer and referenced Apache 2.0 texts remain evidence to review; no legal assurance, third-party image rights or redistribution approval follows. Model/compiled files, raw vectors, raw errors and private paths stay outside the repository.
localArtifactReferencesResolution: Resolve from this JSON directory; selected local hash references only, without copying model, source, compiled files, vectors or private runtime contents.
